model: AVC6000 AccuValve airflow control valve (fume hood and set point modes)
applies_to: Accutrol AVC6000 AccuValve airflow control valves with the valve-mounted controller, in fume hood mode or a set point mode (supply / general exhaust).
summary: The AVC6000 is a valve-mounted airflow controller for lab supply, exhaust and fume hood valves, on BACnet MS/TP. It reports measured airflow, valve position and the active setpoint; in fume hood mode it adds face velocity, sash position, hood alarms and purge. The airflow setpoint can come from an analog input, dry contacts or a BACnet AV, and MSI 2 shows which mode is active.
notes: The manual prints two tables: Fume Hood Mode (all 31 objects here) and Set Point Mode, which is the same list without AI 4-6, BI 2-5, BV 1, BV 3-5 and MSI 4. They are combined; fume-hood-only objects are marked.
Object names are not printed; the Description column is used, with the state text moved to states.
MSI (multistate input) objects are listed as MI. MSI 3 and MSI 4 are writable per the table.
Units of AI/AV/AO objects follow MSI 3 and MSI 4; values are stored internally in US units.
AI 2 is invalid in BACnet setpoint mode and fume hood mode; AV 1 is invalid in AI setpoint mode and fume hood mode; AV 3 is invalid in fume hood mode.

integration.summary: Check MSI 2 first: it shows whether the setpoint comes from the analog input, dry contacts, AV 1 or the fume hood logic. In BACnet setpoint mode write the airflow setpoint to AV 1 and read AI 1 and AI 8 back. In fume hood mode read face velocity, sash position and the hood alarms; BV 1 requests purge.

minimum_points.name: Airflow Volume Setpoint to Control Loop
Mode Selector
minimum_points.why: Control mode; 3 = BACnet setpoint, 4 = fume hood

integration.enable: The setpoint source is the controller's mode (MSI 2, read-only over BACnet); AV 1 only controls airflow in BACnet setpoint mode (MSI 2 = 3). The mode is configured with the Insight tool.
setup: BACnet MS/TP on EIA-485; the device instance is set by writing Object_Identifier (the wildcard instance 4194303 works).
Disconnect the Insight USB and Bluetooth links during BACnet operation to avoid conflicts.
AV 2 sets an unsubscribed COV broadcast interval; up to 40 COV subscriptions are supported.
gotchas: BV 2 writes the configuration to flash, which allows only 10,000 writes (AI 7 counts what is left); never write it cyclically.
The internal loop drives AO 1 at priority 10; writing it at a higher priority overrides airflow control.
The manual itself recommends an analog signal for the airflow setpoint over BACnet MS/TP.
